name: TPS62130
description: 17 V, 3 A synchronous buck in a 3×3 mm QFN with power-good, soft-start/tracking and pin-selectable 2.5/1.25 MHz, for compact 3.3 V/5 V rails.
notes: FSW pin: low = 2.5 MHz, high = 1.25 MHz (better efficiency).
17 V max: 12 V rails and up to 3S LiPo only.

en.note: Abs max is VIN + 0.3 V (AVIN/PVIN abs max 20 V), so EN can tie straight to VIN. The typical app (Fig. 9-1) ties EN to AVIN/PVIN. Logic: high >= 0.9 V (0.65 typ), low <= 0.3 V. EN must be driven high or low; the internal ~400k pull-down only holds a pin that was low and then floats (it disconnects when EN is high). Do not rely on floating.

pg.note: Open drain. Pull up to any voltage < 7 V (typical app: 100k R3 to VOUT). Sinks 2 mA at spec low level, 10 mA abs max. TPS62130: high-Z when off. TPS62130A: PG low when off. Thresholds 95% rising / 90% falling. If unused, connect to GND or leave floating.

extras.note: Low = 2.5 MHz typ (default for this design). High = 1.25 MHz for efficiency: tie to VOUT or PG, NOT VIN (7 V abs max). It must start Low to limit inrush, which a VOUT/PG connection gives. Use L >= 2.2 µH at 1.25 MHz. Internal ~400k pull-down only holds a pin that was set low and then floats.
Low = nominal VOUT. High = VOUT + 5% (margining): tie to VOUT or PG, not VIN (7 V abs max). Internal ~400k pull-down when floating after being set low.

Soft-start: CSS = tSS x 2.5 µA / 1.25 V (Eq. 10), ISS/TR = 2.5 µA typ. The typical app µses 3.3 nF, about 1.65 ms. Leaving SS/TR open gives the fastest start-up (allowed). It can also take a tracking voltage (VFB ~ 0.64 x VSS/TR, 50 mV-1.2 V). Abs max VIN + 0.3 V.
Output sense and control-loop input. Connect at the output capacitor by the shortest path, away from the inductor. An internal 25 pF feed-forward cap sits between VOS and FB.

Control supply. Must be fed from the same source as PVIN (pins 11, 12). The 0.1 µF (cinHf) must sit at AVIN to AGND to avoid noise coupling. An optional RC low-pass PVIN to AVIN is allowed but not required.

notes: DCS-Control, internally compensated. 2.5 MHz (FSW Low) or 1.25 MHz (FSW High) nominal in PWM. PSM at light load.

R1 (top) = R2 x (VOUT/0.8 V - 1) (Eq. 6). Divider current must be >= 2 µA, so R2 <= 400 kΩ. Lower values are recommended for accuracy. The only adjustable example in the datasheet (2.5 V, Fig. 9-45) µses R1 = 390k, R2 = 180k.
Internal 25 pF feed-forward cap VOS-FB: fzero = 1/(2 pi R1 25 pF), fpole = 1/(2 pi 25 pF) x (1/R1 + 1/R2). External CFF is optional, not in the typical app.

Proven LC combos (Table 9-2, nominal): 1 µH with 22/47/100/200 µF; 2.2 µH with 10/22/47/100/200 µF; 3.3 µH with 10/22/47/100 µF. Standard: 2.2 µH + 22 µF. 1 µH only with FSW Low. Use 2.2 µH for FSW High or low VIN. The typical app labels L as '1 / 2.2 µH'; its component list µses 2.2 µH XFL4020-222.
Inductor peak: IL(max) = IOUT(max) + dIL/2, where dIL = VOUT x (1 - VOUT/VIN(max)) / (L(min) x fSW) (Eq. 7-8). Add ~20% margin. Dynamic HS peak = ILIMF + (VIN - VOUT) x 30 ns / L.
ILIMF (HS static) is 3.6/4.2/4.9 A min/typ/max. Low-side limit 3.5 A typ. Below 0.5 V output, the limit drops to 1.6 A.
On-time ~ VOUT/VIN x 400 ns (FSW Low), with an absolute minimum ~80 ns (approximate, text only). 100% duty mode supported.
Input 10 µF ceramic (1210, 25 V in typical app) at PVIN-PGND plus 0.1 µF at AVIN-AGND (required). Output 22 µF 6.3 V 0805 X5R/X7R.
Pin list: AVIN (10) and PVIN (11, 12) are separate pins that are both 'VIN'. Thermal pad must be soldered.
